goal: Prevent nodes from wasting CPU and memory deserializing malformed or pathological network messages
Reject oversized blocks and floods of empty transactions immediately at the network stream layer
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile with nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Concern that dropped blocks could stall downloads until timeout was addressed (Yudis-bit)
Questioned if complexity of final commits is worth it, answered with planned benchmarks (maflcko)
Suggested scoping budget lifetime with a wrapper rather than mutable state, which was adopted (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents network DoS attacks that exhaust memory and CPU before validation runs
Stops attackers from packing 400,000 empty transactions or quadruple weight limits into a 4 MB block

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it adds stateful parameter tracking to the shared serialization framework
Allows streams to track cumulative metrics across nested objects without breaking abstractions
